name: Build hotdogb kernel (KSU Next + SUSFS)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      reference_boot_url:
        description: Official LineageOS boot.img matching the installed build
        required: true
        default: https://mirrorbits.lineageos.org/full/hotdogb/20261113/boot.img
      reference_boot_sha256:
        description: Optional SHA-256 of the reference boot.img
        required: false
        type: string
  push:
    branches:
      - ksun-susfs
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/build-kernel-susfs.yml'
      - 'arch/arm64/configs/**'
      - 'drivers/Kconfig'
      - 'drivers/input/**'
      - 'drivers/Makefile'
      - 'drivers/kernelsu/**'
      - 'ksu-next-manual-hooks.patch'
      - 'ksu-next-4.14-compat.patch'
      - 'susfs-*.patch'
      - 'fs/**'
      - 'include/**'
      - 'kernel/**'
      - 'security/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      ARCH: arm64
      SUBARCH: arm64
      CROSS_COMPILE: aarch64-linux-gnu-
      CLANG_TRIPLE: aarch64-linux-gnu-
      LLVM: 1
      LLVM_IAS: 1
      KBUILD_BUILD_USER: github-actions
      KBUILD_BUILD_HOST: hotdogb-ci
      KSU_NEXT_COMMIT: 8af3d4fec33be32fa5d3f8dae4f380fac45bf2cd
      SUSFS_COMMIT: d36aa6aba911a47b9de6b88ba0f621c81581656d

    steps:
      - name: Check out kernel source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            bc bison flex libssl-dev libncurses-dev python3 \
            curl ca-certificates git zip unzip xz-utils cpio file

      - name: Cache Android toolchains
        id: toolchain-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/toolchains
          key: android-clang-r383902-gcc49-v1

      - name: Download AOSP Clang r383902 and GCC 4.9
        if: steps.toolchain-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        env:
          CLANG_URL: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/prebuilts/clang/host/linux-x86/+archive/refs/tags/android-11.0.0_r1/clang-r383902.tar.gz
          GCC_URL: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/prebuilts/gcc/linux-x86/aarch64/aarch64-linux-android-4.9/+archive/refs/tags/android-11.0.0_r1.tar.gz
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchains/clang-r383902"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchains/aarch64-linux-android-4.9"
          curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors "$CLANG_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/clang.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/clang.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchains/clang-r383902"
          curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors "$GCC_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gcc.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/gcc.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchains/aarch64-linux-android-4.9"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchains/clang-r383902/bin/clang" --version

      - name: Integrate SUSFS 1.4.2 and apply manual hooks
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail
          git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout \
            https://gitlab.com/simonpunk/susfs4ksu.git susfs4ksu
          git -C susfs4ksu checkout "$SUSFS_COMMIT"
          test "$(git -C susfs4ksu rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SUSFS_COMMIT"
          git apply --check susfs-lineageos-4.14.patch
          git apply susfs-lineageos-4.14.patch
          cp susfs4ksu/kernel_patches/fs/susfs.c fs/susfs.c
          cp susfs4ksu/kernel_patches/fs/sus_su.c fs/sus_su.c
          cp susfs4ksu/kernel_patches/include/linux/susfs.h include/linux/susfs.h
          cp susfs4ksu/kernel_patches/include/linux/sus_su.h include/linux/sus_su.h
          git apply --check ksu-next-manual-hooks.patch
          git apply ksu-next-manual-hooks.patch
          git apply --check susfs-manual-prctl-hook.patch
          git apply susfs-manual-prctl-hook.patch

      - name: Set up KernelSU Next v3.4.0-legacy
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail
          git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout \
            https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next.git KernelSU-Next
          git -C KernelSU-Next checkout "$KSU_NEXT_COMMIT"
          test "$(git -C KernelSU-Next rev-parse HEAD)" = "$KSU_NEXT_COMMIT"
          git -C KernelSU-Next apply --check ../susfs-ksun-next-v3.4.0-legacy.patch
          git -C KernelSU-Next apply ../susfs-ksun-next-v3.4.0-legacy.patch
          git -C KernelSU-Next apply --check ../ksu-next-4.14-compat.patch
          git -C KernelSU-Next apply ../ksu-next-4.14-compat.patch
          ln -s ../KernelSU-Next/kernel drivers/kernelsu
          grep -q 'kernelsu' drivers/Makefile || \
            printf '\nobj-$(CONFIG_KSU) += kernelsu/\n' >> drivers/Makefile
          grep -q 'source "drivers/kernelsu/Kconfig"' drivers/Kconfig || \
            sed -i '/endmenu/i\source "drivers/kernelsu/Kconfig"' drivers/Kconfig

      - name: Verify manual hooks
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail
          grep -q 'ksu_handle_execveat_ksud' fs/exec.c
          grep -q 'ksu_handle_vfs_read' fs/read_write.c
          grep -q 'ksu_handle_faccessat' fs/open.c
          grep -q 'ksu_handle_stat' fs/stat.c
          grep -q 'ksu_handle_newfstat_ret' fs/stat.c
          grep -q 'ksu_handle_input_handle_event' drivers/input/input.c
          grep -q 'ksu_handle_sys_reboot' kernel/reboot.c
          grep -q 'ksu_handle_prctl' kernel/sys.c
          test -s fs/susfs.c
          test -s include/linux/susfs.h
          grep -q 'CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_KSTAT' fs/inode.c
          grep -q 'CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_MOUNT' fs/proc_namespace.c

      - name: Configure kernel
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail
          export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchains/clang-r383902/bin:$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchains/aarch64-linux-android-4.9/bin:$PATH"
          make O=out vendor/sm8150-perf_defconfig
          scripts/kconfig/merge_config.sh -m -O out out/.config arch/arm64/configs/vendor/oplus.config
          scripts/config --file out/.config \
            -e KSU -e KSU_MANUAL_HOOK -e QCA_CLD_WLAN \
            -e KSU_SUSFS -e KSU_SUSFS_SUS_PATH -e KSU_SUSFS_SUS_MOUNT \
            -e KSU_SUSFS_SUS_KSTAT -e KSU_SUSFS_SUS_OVERLAYFS \
            -e KSU_SUSFS_TRY_UMOUNT -e KSU_SUSFS_SPOOF_UNAME \
            -e KSU_SUSFS_ENABLE_LOG \
            -d KSU_KPROBES_HOOK -d KSU_SYSCALL_TABLE_HOOK -d KSU_SUSFS_SUS_SU
          make O=out olddefconfig
          grep -E '^CONFIG_KSU=|^CONFIG_KSU_MANUAL_HOOK=|^CONFIG_QCA_CLD_WLAN=|^CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS' out/.config
          test "$(scripts/config --file out/.config -s KSU)" = y
          test "$(scripts/config --file out/.config -s KSU_MANUAL_HOOK)" = y
          test "$(scripts/config --file out/.config -s QCA_CLD_WLAN)" = y
          for opt in KSU_SUSFS KSU_SUSFS_SUS_PATH KSU_SUSFS_SUS_MOUNT \
            KSU_SUSFS_SUS_KSTAT KSU_SUSFS_SUS_OVERLAYFS KSU_SUSFS_TRY_UMOUNT \
            KSU_SUSFS_SPOOF_UNAME KSU_SUSFS_ENABLE_LOG; do
            test "$(scripts/config --file out/.config -s "$opt")" = y
          done
          test "$(scripts/config --file out/.config -s KSU_SUSFS_SUS_SU)" = n
          cp out/.config dist-hotdogb.config

      - name: Build kernel and modules
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchains/clang-r383902/bin:$RUNNER_TEMP/toolchains/aarch64-linux-android-4.9/bin:$PATH"
          make O=out -j"$(nproc)" Image modules 2>&1 | tee build.log
          test -s out/arch/arm64/boot/Image
          file out/arch/arm64/boot/Image

      - name: Package AnyKernel3 and repack boot.img
        env:
          REFERENCE_BOOT_URL: ${{ inputs.reference_boot_url || 'https://mirrorbits.lineageos.org/full/hotdogb/20261113/boot.img' }}
          REFERENCE_BOOT_SHA256: ${{ inputs.reference_boot_sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euxo pipefail
          SHORT_SHA="${GITHUB_SHA::7}"
          DIST="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist"
          mkdir -p "$DIST"

          cp out/arch/arm64/boot/Image "$DIST/Image"
          cp dist-hotdogb.config "$DIST/hotdogb.config"
          cp out/Module.symvers "$DIST/Module.symvers"
          find out -name '*.ko' -type f -exec cp {} "$DIST/" \;

          # qcacld is built into Image (CONFIG_QCA_CLD_WLAN=y), so this build
          # intentionally has no external qca_cld3_wlan.ko or KSU WLAN module.
          test ! -e out/drivers/staging/qcacld-3.0/wlan.ko

          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/osm0sis/AnyKernel3.git "$RUNNER_TEMP/AnyKernel3"
          cp out/arch/arm64/boot/Image "$RUNNER_TEMP/AnyKernel3/Image"
          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/AnyKernel3/anykernel.sh" <<'EOF'
          # AnyKernel3 Ramdisk Mod Script
          # OnePlus 7T (hotdogb), LineageOS 24.0

          properties() { '
          kernel.string=hotdogb LineageOS 24.0 KernelSU Next kernel
          do.devicecheck=1
          device.name1=hotdogb
          device.name2=OnePlus7T
          device.name3=oneplus7t
          BLOCK=boot
          IS_SLOT_DEVICE=1
          RAMDISK_COMPRESSION=auto
          PATCH_VBMETA_FLAG=auto
          '; }

          . tools/ak3-core.sh;
          dump_boot;
          write_boot;
          EOF

          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/AnyKernel3"
          zip -r9 "$DIST/hotdogb-ksun-susfs-$SHORT_SHA-AnyKernel3.zip" . \
            -x '.git/*' README.md 'ramdisk/*' 'patch/*'
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

          curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors "$REFERENCE_BOOT_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/reference-boot.img"
          if [ -n "$REFERENCE_BOOT_SHA256" ]; then
            echo "$REFERENCE_BOOT_SHA256  $RUNNER_TEMP/reference-boot.img" | sha256sum -c -
          fi

          git clone --depth 1 https://android.googlesource.com/platform/system/tools/mkbootimg "$RUNNER_TEMP/mkbootimg"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/unpacked-boot"
          python3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/mkbootimg/unpack_bootimg.py" \
            --boot_img "$RUNNER_TEMP/reference-boot.img" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/unpacked-boot" --format mkbootimg -0 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mkbootimg.args"
          mapfile -d '' -t MKBOOTIMG_ARGS < "$RUNNER_TEMP/mkbootimg.args"
          python3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/mkbootimg/mkbootimg.py" "${MKBOOTIMG_ARGS[@]}" \
            --kernel out/arch/arm64/boot/Image \
            --output "$DIST/hotdogb-ksun-susfs-$SHORT_SHA-boot.img"

          cd "$DIST"
          sha256sum ./* > SHA256SUMS

      - name: Upload build artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: hotdogb-ksun-susfs-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: |
            dist/
            build.log
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Build summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          {
            echo '## hotdogb KernelSU Next + SUSFS kernel';
            echo;
            echo "- Commit: \`$GITHUB_SHA\`";
            echo '- KernelSU Next: v3.4.0-legacy (manual hooks), pinned commit `$KSU_NEXT_COMMIT`';
            echo '- WLAN: built into the kernel (`CONFIG_QCA_CLD_WLAN=y`), no KSU WLAN module required';
            echo '- SUSFS: 1.4.2-kernel-4.14, pinned commit `$SUSFS_COMMIT`';
            echo '- Flash only after checking the artifact and reference boot build.';
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
